summary: Operator growth topology is tested on Single Node OpenShift with 32 GB RAM, 16 CPUs, 128 GB disk and 3000 IOPS, with one pod each for controller web/task, hub web/API/Redis, EDA API/activation worker/default worker/event stream/scheduler, gateway, database and Redis, plus 2 hub content and 2 hub worker pods. The supported diagram has external Redis and PostgreSQL. Multiple isolated AAP instances can share a cluster with namespace-scoped deployments.
